**Finding: compliant (no redline).**

Section 24 of the Cobalt Cloud agreement meets our preferred ASSIGN position:

- **24.1** — Customer may assign to an Affiliate or an M&A/asset-sale successor **without Vendor's consent** (prompt notice + assignee assumption only). "Affiliate" is defined at 1.1 on a >50% control test.
- **24.2** — Vendor may not assign, delegate material performance, or transfer by change of control without our prior written consent (not unreasonably withheld), and may never assign to a direct Customer competitor.
- **24.4** — Our change of control gives Vendor **no** right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees, or reduce service — the walk-away trigger is expressly negated.
- **24.3** — Confirmed it does not undercut 24.1: it governs only "other assignments" outside the 24.1/24.2 carve-outs, on a mutual not-unreasonably-withheld standard.
- **13.3** — Independently preserves our licence-transfer right on a permitted Section 24 assignment.

Only minor point noted, not redlined: the competitor bar reads "direct Customer competitor without Customer's consent" rather than an absolute prohibition — immaterial given Vendor assignment already requires our consent in every case.
